`solve_model` still takes its callback snapshots from `n.snapshots`, rather than from the model’s stored snapshots. `_as_model_snapshots` only converts toward flat representation; if a model was built with a MultiIndex and the network’s snapshots subsequently become a plain index, it passes that plain index through unchanged. Thus the model’s build-time representation is not guaranteed for every network and call path.
